calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, compute the negative one-session return divided by trailing 10-session return volatility, then take a three-session trailing mean. Higher values indicate stronger recent risk-adjusted weakness and a contrarian long signal. All inputs are lagged completed sessions at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.043427; 766 dates), 2023-2024 (0.019801; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.022624; 574 dates). Predictive power is strongest at the one-day horizon and decays by 10 sessions.
